review.reason: Candidate 36 passes as supplied. Hole 1 is a 500-yard reachable par 5 with substantial water on the right of play. The broad landing corridor supports a staged route away from the shoreline, while advancing aggressively offers a chance to reach in two. Hole 2 is a 171-yard straight par 3 with water left/front of the target; the hazard adds consequence without forcing an unreasonable carry, and the tee-safe options support a playable shot. Hole 3 is a dry 350-yard narrow-corridor par 4. Its fairway bunkers and limited safe tee options make placement important, but the preview retains a usable corridor and a clear route to the green. The reachable par 5, short water-influenced par 3, and tighter dry par 4 give the round strong internal contrast. Across-days variety is good: water has featured often in recent rounds, but this set avoids an island green and uses a narrow-corridor finisher rather than repeating the more common punchbowl or dogleg patterns. The 24 safe tee options on Hole 3 merit attention, but the landing route remains playable; the other holes have 48 and 49 safe options. No geometry edits are needed.
